title: Yuuji Oono, Music Composer of 'Lupin the Third', Dies at 84
content: Yuuji Oono , the acclaimed jazz pianist and composer renowned for scoring the anime series Lupin III , died on May 4, 2026. He was 84. His agency, Office Augusta, announced his passing in an official statement on May 13, expressing heartfelt gratitude for the support and kindness shown to him throughout his lifetime.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Tamekō's Lala's Married Life Manga Enters Final Arc
content: Libre Publishing confirmed on Saturday that Tamekō 's Lala's Married Life ( LaLa no Kekkon ) manga has entered its final arc with its ninth volume, which shipped on the same day.
author: ANN

title: The One Piece Spice Kit by McCormick Lets You Eat like a Pirate
content: Everyone wants a piece of One Piece, and that includes McCormick®. The spice and seasoning giant has released a limited edition pack of One Piece -inspired seasonings. Retailing for $25.99 (MSRP), the One Piece spice kit includes four different seasoning blends.
author: Anime Corner

title: Takashi Tezuka to Retire From Nintendo in June
content: Nintendo announced on Friday that executive officer Takashi Tezuka will retire on June 26. Tezuka began his career at Nintendo in 1984, working side-by-side with Shigeru Miyamoto on the Mario series since Super Mario Bros. and then on The Legend of Zelda series since the first game.
author: ANN

title: Talentless Nana Manga to End in 2 More Chapters
content: The June issue of Square Enix 's Monthly Shonen Gangan magazine reported on Tuesday that Looseboy and Iori Furuya 's Talentless Nana ( Munō na Nana ) manga will end in two more chapters. If there are no delays, the manga will end in July. Square Enix 's Manga UP!

title: Ultraman Franchise Gets 60th Anniversary Documentary Film on July 3
content: Tsuburaya Productions announced on April 20 that its Ultraman tokusatsu franchise will have a documentary film titled The Origin of Ultraman . The documentary's website began streaming a trailer on Thursday, revealing its July 3 opening date.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Zelda Film to Open 1 Week Sooner on April 30, 2027
content: The Legend of Zelda game co-creator Shigeru Miyamoto announced on Wednesday that the franchise 's live-action film's opening date is now set for April 30, 2027, a week earlier from its previously planned May 7, 2027 opening date.
author: ANN
